verdict.rationale: Crash-reporting tools can reasonably ship an end-user feedback widget, so this axis applies to Raygun. However, the evidence pack documents no crash-report dialog or user-feedback collection tied to error events. The only comment feature is a team-side link from the AI chat into an error group's comments, which is not end-user feedback.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
